test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Two border guards patrolling/the nearby frontier with Georgia have also/been reported missing from Friday night.

options.text: the nearby frontier with Georgia have also
been reported missing from Friday night.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"****been reported missing from Friday night."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"been reported missing from Friday night."**
 
• The error was in the use of** "from"** instead of **"since"** to indicate the starting point of the reported missing duration.
 
• **"Since" **is the appropriate term to use when referring to a specific starting time or point in the past.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *Two border guards patrolling the nearby frontier with Georgia have also **been reported missing since Friday night**__.*
